messages:
alex_oncall: head's up — seeing a spike of apiserver 503 responses in us-east-2 and ap-south1 for the last 8m. controller-manager leader switching ~every 20s. GPU pool attach requests are timing out, causing node provisioning to backlog.
maya: ugh, same. gpu-attach errors look like: 
```
E0305 12:34:01 controller.go:412] failed to attach GPU to node node-xyz: timeout waiting for attach status
```
sam: any recent iam/kube-apiserver restarts? or network flaps between controlplane and etcd?
jordan: I see increased etcd proposal latency around 12:33:50 in eu-west logs — multiple slow disk spikes on leader. Not a full election but leader is getting behind. Could explain controller-manager leader heartbeats missing.
lenora: rolling window shows apiserver latency p95 jumped from 60ms -> 1.8s, errors for PATCH/POST on /api/v1/nodes/proxy. GPU autoscaler keeps retrying and creates attach storms.
alex_oncall: can someone grab `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system` from one of affected masters and share? Also paste controller-manager logs for leader election lines.
maya: endpoints look fine, apiserver endpoints present. controller-manager logs: 
```
I0305 12:34:02 leaderelection.go:242] attempting to acquire leader lease  kube-system/controller-manager...
I0305 12:34:22 leaderelection.go:252] successfully acquired lease, renewing...
I0305 12:34:42 leaderelection.go:287] lost lease: context deadline exceeded
```
sam: that pattern matches heartbeat timeouts. Could be transient network packet loss or CPU contention on masters causing process scheduling delays. Any recent infra changes?
jordan: storage team reports small iops saturation for the etcd WAL disk in us-east-2 during a batch snapshot job at 12:33. They throttled the snapshot but the pauses were ~150-300ms — enough to push etcd apply behind.
lenora: consequence: controller-manager can't persist leader renew timestamp -> loses lease -> quick re-elections -> controllers rebind -> kubelet/gpu-attach ops retry -> attach thundering -> more apiserver load. Feedback loop.
alex_oncall: mitigation steps: 1) pause gpu autoscaler scale-ups for affected regions (temp quiesce). 2) ask storage to throttle snapshots in controlplane region or move snapshot offpeak. 3) increase controller-manager lease duration to tolerate brief WAL pauses?
maya: can we patch lease duration quickly? it's in cluster config but changes need rollout across masters — risky during instability. Prefer rate-limiting autoscaler and pausing heavy background ops.
sam: oncall can run `kubectl patch cm kube-controller-manager -n kube-system --patch '{"data":{"leader-elect-lease-duration":"30s"}}'` ? Not sure if we read config from componentconfig or static manifest.
jordan: on these clusters controller-manager is a static pod — change the manifest on each master. Not great during flapping.
infra-bot: incident-notice: controlplane-degradation-us-east-2 started at 2026-03-05T12:35:00Z. Affected: GPU attach, autoscaler retries, node provisioning delays.
lenora: for short term I disabled GPU autoscaler by setting annotation `sre/scale-disabled=true` on the autoscaler CR in us-east-2; this stopped new attach storms. Observed reduction in apiserver 5xx after ~45s.
alex_oncall: great. storage team — can you postpone scheduled snapshots for 10m and confirm WAL io qdepth?
jordan: snapshots paused. WAL io qdepth dropped from 18 -> 4 and etcd propose latency returned to normal (p95 ~70ms). controller-manager has held leader for ~2m now.
maya: monitoring: will keep autoscaler disabled for 15m, then re-enable with a throttled concurrency (maxParallelAttaches=2). Also add a K8s admission rate limit on node attach requests via webhook?
sam: longer term: increase WAL IO provision on controlplane disks and introduce backpressure in autoscaler to avoid thundering. Also add a controller-manager lease-duration circuit (config-based) that can be increased during degradation.
alex_oncall: cost note — increasing disk iops in controlplane region will add ~$X/day. But cheaper than hours of failed provisioning. I'll raise a quick ops budget approval.
lenora: we should also add a post-incident eval: replicate snapshot job in staging to measure WAL pause impact on leader election and GPU attach path.
alex_oncall: TL;DR: paused autoscaler, storage paused snapshots, leader stabilized, GPU attaches resumed. keeping thread open for 30m to observe, will file incident ticket with timeline. :thumbsup:
